<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>2023 Hybrid Test | Selective Prep</title><style>
:root{--bg:#f5f7fb;--card:#fff;--ink:#182230;--muted:#667085;--blue:#2563eb;--green:#15803d;--red:#b42318;--line:#d0d5dd}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}a{color:#1d4ed8;text-decoration:none}.top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:#111827;color:white;padding:10px 16px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}.brand{font-weight:800}.timer{font-weight:900;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;border:2px solid white;border-radius:10px;padding:6px 12px;min-width:105px;text-align:center}.timer:before{content:"TIME LEFT ";display:block;font-size:.65rem}.warn{background:#b45309}.critical{background:#b91c1c;animation:pulse 1s infinite}@keyframes pulse{50%{transform:scale(1.04)}}.wrap{max-width:1400px;margin:auto;padding:18px}.card{background:white;border:1px solid #e4e7ec;border-radius:14px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(16,24,40,.08)}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:16px}.exam{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 330px;gap:16px}.side{position:sticky;top:74px;height:fit-content}.primary{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 15px;font-weight:700}.secondary{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:10px 15px;font-weight:700}.danger{background:white;border:1px solid #fda29b;color:var(--red);border-radius:9px;padding:9px 13px}.status,.small{color:var(--muted)}.qimg{display:block;max-width:100%;width:auto;height:auto;margin:8px auto;background:white}.source-label,.question-label{font-weight:800;font-size:.77rem;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#475467;margin:12px 0 5px}.question-label{color:#1d4ed8}.choices{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:16px 0}.choice{min-width:58px;padding:13px 18px;border:2px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:10px;background:white;font-weight:800}.choice.sel{border-color:var(--blue);background:#eff6ff;color:#1d4ed8}.qgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:7px;margin:12px 0}.qnum{padding:8px 0;border:1px solid var(--line);background:white;border-radius:7px;font-weight:700}.qnum.answered{background:#dcfce7;border-color:#86efac}.qnum.flagged{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #f59e0b}.qnum.current{outline:3px solid var(--blue)}.nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.metricgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:12px;margin:16px 0}.metric{border:1px solid #e4e7ec;border-radius:10px;padding:14px;text-align:center}.metric b{display:block;font-size:1.5rem}.wrong{color:var(--red)}.correct{color:var(--green)}@media(max-width:900px){.exam{grid-template-columns:1fr}.side{position:static}.top{position:static}}
</style></head><body><div id="app"></div><script>
